captions.detailed: This is a 3D model of a workshop box fan featuring a matte black, square outer housing with rounded corners and a protective wire grid on both the front and back. It is supported by a light gray tubular floor cradle that allows the entire fan housing to tilt on a horizontal axis. Inside, a five-blade black propeller is mounted on a central shaft, and a black multi-lobed selector knob is located on the lower right side of the housing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a workshop box fan with a square black housing, a light gray tubular floor cradle, and a side selector knob. The housing should be able to tilt on horizontal pivots, the central five-blade propeller should spin continuously, and the selector knob should rotate on its axis.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by creating a base cradle using cylinder primitives arranged in a 'U' shape with ground support bars. A square housing is built using a rounded box with a hollowed center, populated with a grid of intersecting thin cylinders. The propeller is made from a central hub cylinder with five extruded blade profiles. A multi-lobed selector knob is modeled and attached to the side. Revolute joints are then defined to connect the cradle to the housing, the housing to the propeller, and the housing to the selector knob.
